entities.name: Rinni
entities.description: Cult of Rakdos ring member on Ravnica whose final Showstopper made Rakdos laugh.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon of the Cult of Rakdos, pleased by Rinni's act.

entities.name: Lunicia
entities.description: Girl who wished to join Rinni's ring and resolved to outdo his show.

entities.name: Silar
entities.description: Orzhov priest who offered to track Lunicia down.

entities.name: Minyuli
entities.description: Ring member whose performance Lunicia watched.

events.summary: Lunicia asks to join the ring; Rinni refuses and she spits in his face.
events.quote: Rinni initially refused to sign a contract with her, angered her, and she spit in his face.

events.summary: Silar offers to track Lunicia down but Rinni declines.
events.quote: but Rinni declined, thinking the girl had spirit

events.summary: Rinni finds Lunicia and signs her into the ring.
events.quote: he finally signed the paper, allowing her to become a member of their ring

events.summary: Rinni, Nikori and Ginoria drink potions and die in a fiery final Showstopper; Rakdos laughs.
events.quote: all three of them went out with a bang

events.summary: Lunicia resolves to stage a show that makes Rakdos roar with pleasure.
events.quote: resolved to set up a show in the future that would outdo this performance

relations.quote: Rinni was a Cult of Rakdos ring member
Rinni was part of a three-pronged act along with Nikori and Ginoria
